# jumpcloud_user (Data Source)

Looks up a JumpCloud user by email. Fails unless exactly one user matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_user" "ana" {
  email = "ana@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address, matched exactly and case-sensitively.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) Custom attributes, keyed by name.
- `department` (String) Department.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `job_title` (String) Job title.
- `state` (String) Account state, such as `ACTIVATED`, `STAGED`, or `SUSPENDED`.
- `username` (String) Username.
